headline: Policy changes on school resource officers, homeless students, and bomb threats, plus school calendars for 2027/2028 and 2028/2029.
summary: The agenda lists policy rescissions, adoptions, and revisions, along with school calendars and 2027 meeting dates for a second review. It also includes grants, staff hires and resignations, enrollment, and a financial dashboard.
